# assemble best estimate of true process data:

true_df["y_true_est"] = true_df["y_lab"].fillna(true_df["y_obs"])

# fit quadratic mean in T to estimated true purity
X = np.column_stack([
    np.ones(len(true_df)),
    true_df["T"].values,
    true_df["T"].values**2
])
y = true_df["y_true_est"].values
beta, *_ = np.linalg.lstsq(X, y, rcond=None)
true_df["fit"] = X @ beta
resid_sd = float(np.std(y - true_df["fit"].values, ddof=3))

print("beta:", beta)
print("resid_sd:", resid_sd)
print("\nmeans by T using y_true_est:")
print(true_df.groupby("T")["y_true_est"].agg(["mean","std","count"]))
print("\nlab-corrected rows:")
print(true_df[true_df["y_lab"].notna()][["lot_id","T","y_obs","y_lab","y_true_est"]])
